tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the Farmhouse Chocolates online shop (handmade in Bristol, Vermont): chocolate-covered salted caramels, dark chocolate truffles, organic 2 oz chocolate bars and gift bundles. Returns live retail prices in USD, availability and the product page URL. Leave the query empty to list everything.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Full details for one product: description, ingredients, allergen statement, storage and shelf life, the choices offered at checkout (flavor, size), and each size with its price and availability. Pass the handle or URL from search_products.

tools.name: recommend_gifts
tools.description: Gift ideas from Farmhouse Chocolates for a budget, occasion and diet: Vermont-made holiday and Christmas gifts, stocking stuffers, host and thank-you gifts, birthdays, client gifts. Every suggestion is a real product at its live price, gift-wrapped with a handwritten note, shipped to all 50 US state

tools.name: find_stores
tools.description: Shops, cafés and markets that carry Farmhouse Chocolates, from our public Where to Buy map. Search by town, state or shop name, and/or near a latitude and longitude. Stock varies; suggest calling the shop first.
